title: Triangulations of standard parabolic facets of root polytopes
author: Paola Cellini
difficulty_reason: After ordinary finite-root-system, Weyl-group and abelian-ideal prerequisites, the author still proves the crossing-pair and detachable/bipartition structure and constructs triangulation orders through all required classical and exceptional root cases. The proof uses these orders to establish rank induction for cone covering, linear independence of reduced subsets and the exact common-face intersection identity. These new structural and geometric induction arguments uniformly produce the facets triangulation and exceed routine doctoral qualification exercises.

contexts.scope: Complete authored body including required crossing/order/case-analysis/core proof and uncounted lattice result
